lines.q: Thirty flags, from easy to legend, and they get harder every round. Keep score! First one: which country's flag is this?
lines.a: Japan! The Japanese call it Hinomaru, the circle of the sun.

lines.q: Which country's flag is this?
lines.a: Italy! Green, white and red, nicknamed Il Tricolore.

lines.q: And this one?
lines.a: Brazil! That blue globe shows the night sky over Rio.

lines.q: Which country's flag is this?
lines.a: France! Blue, white and red, in vertical stripes.

lines.q: What colours are on Germany's flag?
lines.a: Black, red and gold! Nice, you're warming up.

lines.q: Last one of round one. What colours are on Ireland's flag?
lines.a: Green, white and orange! Not red, that's Italy.

lines.q: Round two: medium, and the traps begin. Which country's flag is this?
lines.a: Australia! White stars. New Zealand's stars are red.

lines.q: Which country's flag is this?
lines.a: Turkey! Tunisia's looks close, but its moon sits in a white circle.

lines.q: Which country's flag is this?
lines.a: Nigeria! Designed by a student, Taiwo Akinkunmi, in nineteen fifty nine.

lines.q: Which country has a square national flag?
lines.a: Switzerland! Only Vatican City shares that shape.

lines.q: Brazil's flag has a motto, ordem e progresso. What does it mean?
lines.a: Order and Progress! How's your score so far?

lines.q: Which country's flag is a red circle on green?
lines.a: Bangladesh! And the circle sits slightly off centre.

lines.q: Round three: hard. Stay sharp! Which country's flag is this?
lines.a: Kazakhstan! A golden sun above a soaring steppe eagle.

lines.q: Which country's flag shows a map of its own island?
lines.a: Cyprus! The map is copper coloured, for its old copper mines.

lines.q: Which country's flag has a cedar tree in the middle?
lines.a: Lebanon! The cedar has been its symbol for thousands of years. If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: Which country's flag shows a dragon?
lines.a: Bhutan! It's Druk, the Thunder Dragon.

lines.q: What sits in the middle of Mexico's flag?
lines.a: An eagle eating a snake, on a cactus! You're doing great.

lines.q: Last one of round three. What is in the middle of India's flag?
lines.a: A wheel! The Ashoka Chakra, in navy blue.

lines.q: Round four: very hard. Only the best get these. Which country's flag has a different design on the back?
lines.a: Paraguay! The front has a coat of arms, the back a treasury seal.

lines.q: Which country's flag shows a parrot?
lines.a: Dominica! The sisserou parrot, found nowhere else on Earth.

lines.q: Which country's flag shows a bird of paradise?
lines.a: Papua New Guinea! With the Southern Cross beside it.

lines.q: How many spokes does the wheel on India's flag have?
lines.a: Twenty four! Tough one, right?

lines.q: Which animal is on Sri Lanka's flag?
lines.a: A lion! A golden lion, standing proud.

lines.q: Which country's flag shows a broken trident?
lines.a: Barbados! Broken to mark its break from colonial rule.

lines.q: Final round: legend level! Which country has the oldest national flag still in use?
lines.a: Denmark! Legend says it fell from the sky in twelve nineteen.

lines.q: What is the study of flags called?
lines.a: Vexillology! From vexillum, the Latin word for a flag.

lines.q: What bird flies across Kiribati's flag?
lines.a: A frigatebird! Soaring over a rising sun.

lines.q: Three left, stay with me! Which country's flag shows a temple?
lines.a: Cambodia! It's Angkor Wat.

lines.q: Haiti and Liechtenstein found out they had the same flag. At which event?
lines.a: The nineteen thirty six Olympics! Liechtenstein then added a crown.

lines.q: Final question. Which country's flag is almost identical to Chad's?
lines.a: Romania! Only the shade of blue is different.

outroLine: How many did you get? Comment your score below, and subscribe with the bell on for a new quiz every day!
